<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Table of Abundance: New Orleans Food Pantry</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lora:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --green-dark:#1F4A2C;
    --green-darker:#173821;
    --green-mid:#4C7A3D;
    --green-pale:#E7EEDE;
    --orange:#CE6A1B;
    --orange-deep:#A6510F;
    --gold:#EFAE33;
    --cream:#F6F1E4;
    --cream-2:#FBF8F0;
    --charcoal:#2B2519;
    --line:#DED4B9;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(1100px 480px at 15% 0%, rgba(239,174,51,0.10), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(900px 500px at 100% 20%, rgba(76,122,61,0.08), transparent 55%),
      var(--cream-2);
    color:var(--charcoal);
    font-family:'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-size:17px;
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  h1,h2,h3{
    font-family:'Lora', serif;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--green-dark);
    margin:0 0 0.4em 0;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  }
  p{margin:0 0 1em 0;}
  a{color:inherit;}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
  .wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;}
  .measure{max-width:62ch;}

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    *{animation:none !important; transition:none !important;}
  }

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  header.site{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
    background:rgba(251,248,240,0.94);
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:12px 28px;
    max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto;
  }
  .nav-brand{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    font-family:'Lora', serif; font-weight:600; font-size:1.1rem;
    color:var(--green-dark); text-decoration:none;
  }
  .nav-brand img{height:36px; width:36px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:50%;}
  .nav-links{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:26px; list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0;}
  .nav-links a{
    text-decoration:none; font-size:0.95rem; color:var(--charcoal);
    padding:4px 2px; border-bottom:2px solid transparent;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--orange);}
  .nav-cta{
    background:var(--orange); color:#fff !important; padding:9px 18px;
    border-radius:3px; font-weight:600; border-bottom:none !important;
  }
  .nav-cta:hover{background:var(--orange-deep);}
  @media (max-width:820px){
    .nav-links a:not(.nav-cta){display:none;}
  }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero{
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
    padding:0;
    min-height:560px;
    display:flex; align-items:center;
    background:var(--green-darker);
  }
  .hero-illustration{
    position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%;
    object-fit:cover;
    z-index:0;
  }
  .hero-overlay{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    background:linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(23,56,33,0.93) 0%, rgba(23,56,33,0.80) 42%, rgba(23,56,33,0.55) 75%);
    z-index:1;
  }
  .hero-rays{
    position:absolute; top:-15%; right:-10%;
    width:70%; height:140%;
    opacity:0.14;
    pointer-events:none;
    z-index:1;
  }
  .hero-wheat{
    position:absolute; left:-4%; bottom:-8%;
    width:34%; height:auto;
    opacity:0.16;
    pointer-events:none;
    z-index:1;
  }
  .hero-inner{
    position:relative; z-index:2;
    max-width:640px;
    padding:100px 28px 90px;
    margin:0 auto 0 0;
  }
  .wrap.hero-inner{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
  @media (min-width:1120px){
    .hero-inner{margin-left:calc((100% - 1120px)/2 + 28px);}
  }
  .hero-eyebrow{
    font-family:'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.02em;
    color:var(--gold); font-size:0.94rem; margin-bottom:0.8em;
  }
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(2.1rem, 4.6vw, 3.15rem);
    line-height:1.1;
    color:#FBF8F0;
    margin-bottom:0.45em;
  }
  .hero .tagline{
    font-size:1.12rem;
    color:#DCE4D3;
    max-width:48ch; margin:0 0 2em;
  }
  .hero-actions{display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap;}

  .btn{
    display:inline-block;
    padding:13px 26px;
    border-radius:3px;
    text-decoration:none;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:0.98rem;
    border:1.5px solid transparent;
    transition:transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
  }
  .btn-primary{background:var(--orange); color:#fff;}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--orange-deep);}
  .btn-ghost{background:transparent; border-color:#F3EFE1; color:#F3EFE1;}
  .btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);}
  .btn-dark{background:var(--green-dark); color:#fff;}
  .btn-dark:hover{background:var(--green-darker);}

  /* ---------- Value strip ---------- */
  .value-strip{background:var(--cream); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .value-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    padding:44px 0;
  }
  @media (max-width:820px){ .value-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:28px 0;} }
  .value-item{padding:0 24px; border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
  .value-item:first-child{border-left:none;}
  @media (max-width:820px){ .value-item{border-left:none;} }
  .value-item h4{
    font-family:'Lora', serif; color:var(--green-dark); font-size:1.05rem; margin:0 0 6px;
  }
  .value-item p{font-size:0.92rem; margin:0; color:#514A38;}

  /* ---------- Sections ---------- */
  section{padding:80px 0;}
  .section-alt{background:var(--cream);}
  .kicker{
    font-family:'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    color:var(--orange-deep);
    font-size:0.92rem;
    margin-bottom:0.5em;
  }

  /* Donate */
  .donate-panel{
    background:var(--green-dark); color:#F3EFE1;
    border-radius:4px; padding:40px 42px; margin-top:36px;
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.3fr 0.7fr; gap:36px; align-items:center;
  }
  @media (max-width:760px){ .donate-panel{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .donate-panel h3{color:#fff; font-size:1.3rem;}
  .donate-panel p{color:#DCE4D3;}
  .donate-actions{text-align:left;}
  .donate-actions .btn-primary{width:100%; text-align:center;}
  .donate-note{font-size:0.82rem; color:#9BAE92; margin-top:14px; margin-bottom:0;}

  /* Sponsorship */
  .sponsor-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:22px; margin-top:36px;
  }
  @media (max-width:920px){ .sponsor-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);} }
  @media (max-width:560px){ .sponsor-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .sponsor-card{
    background:var(--cream-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:4px;
    padding:26px 22px; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  }
  .sponsor-card.sponsor-featured{border:2px solid var(--gold); box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(239,174,51,0.18);}
  .sponsor-tier{font-family:'Lora', serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.15rem; color:var(--green-dark); margin-bottom:4px;}
  .sponsor-amount{font-family:'Lora', serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.4rem; color:var(--orange-deep); margin-bottom:14px;}
  .sponsor-card ul{margin:0 0 18px; padding-left:1.1em; flex-grow:1;}
  .sponsor-card li{font-size:0.86rem; margin-bottom:7px; color:#514A38;}
  .sponsor-card .btn{text-align:center; font-size:0.92rem; padding:11px 16px;}
  .sponsor-note{font-size:0.9rem; color:#514A38; margin-top:28px;}

  .current-sponsors{margin-top:48px; padding-top:36px; border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .current-sponsors h4{font-family:'Lora', serif; color:var(--green-dark); font-size:1.05rem; margin:0 0 20px;}
  .sponsor-logo-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .sponsor-logo-card{
    background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:4px;
    padding:18px 22px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px;
  }
  .sponsor-logo-card img{height:64px; width:auto; display:block;}
  .sponsor-logo-card .sponsor-logo-text{font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--green-mid);}
  .sponsor-logo-card .sponsor-logo-text strong{display:block; color:var(--green-dark); font-family:'Lora', serif; font-size:1rem;}

  /* Statement of need */
  .stat-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:32px; margin-top:36px;
  }
  @media (max-width:760px){ .stat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .stat-item{border-top:2px solid var(--orange); padding-top:16px;}
  .stat-num{
    font-family:'Lora', serif; font-weight:700; font-size:2.4rem;
    color:var(--green-dark); line-height:1.05; margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .stat-num.stat-num-sm{font-size:1.7rem;}
  .stat-item p{font-size:0.92rem; margin:0; color:#514A38;}
  .stat-source{font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--green-mid); margin-top:22px;}

  /* Backstory */
  .story-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:56px; align-items:center;
  }
  @media (max-width:860px){ .story-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .story-photo{
    border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(31,44,29,0.18);
    aspect-ratio:4/3;
  }
  .story-photo img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover;}
  .fact-list{list-style:none; margin:1.8em 0 0; padding:0; border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .fact-list li{
    display:flex; gap:16px;
    padding:16px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    font-size:0.96rem;
  }
  .fact-list .fact-label{flex:0 0 128px; color:var(--green-mid); font-weight:600;}

  /* Mission statement callout */
  .callout{
    background:var(--green-dark);
    color:#F3EFE1;
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:38px 42px;
    margin-top:36px;
  }
  .callout h3{color:#fff; font-size:1.3rem;}
  .callout p{color:#DCE4D3; margin-bottom:0;}

  /* Programs */
  .program-photo{
    width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/7; border-radius:4px;
    margin:34px 0 8px; box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgba(31,44,29,0.14);
    overflow:hidden; display:block;
    object-fit:cover;
  }
  .program-card{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:220px 1fr; gap:32px;
    padding:32px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .program-card:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  @media (max-width:700px){ .program-card{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:10px;} }
  .program-eyebrow{font-family:'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight:600; color:var(--orange-deep); font-size:0.85rem; letter-spacing:0.02em;}
  .program-card h3{font-size:1.3rem; margin-bottom:0.25em;}

  .steps{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:36px; margin-top:44px;}
  @media (max-width:760px){ .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .step-mark{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-family:'Lora', serif; color:var(--green-mid); font-size:0.95rem; margin-bottom:10px;}
  .step-mark::before{content:""; width:26px; height:1.5px; background:var(--orange); display:inline-block;}
  .step h4{font-family:'Lora', serif; color:var(--green-dark); font-size:1.1rem; margin:0 0 6px;}

  /* Role cards (unused, reserved for future detail cards) */
  .role-card{
    background:var(--cream-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:4px;
    padding:32px 34px; margin-top:28px;
  }
  .section-alt .role-card{background:#fff;}
  .role-head{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:18px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .role-tag{
    display:inline-block; font-size:0.76rem; color:var(--orange-deep);
    border:1px solid var(--orange); border-radius:20px; padding:3px 12px;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .role-card h3{font-size:1.25rem; margin:0;}
  .role-card ul{margin:14px 0 0; padding-left:1.2em;}
  .role-card li{margin-bottom:6px; font-size:0.96rem;}
  .role-meta{font-size:0.88rem; color:var(--green-mid); font-weight:600; margin-top:16px;}

  /* Why grid (feature grid, 8 items) */
  .why-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:1px;
    background:var(--line); border:1px solid var(--line); margin-top:36px;
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .why-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);} }
  @media (max-width:520px){ .why-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .why-cell{background:var(--cream-2); padding:28px 24px;}
  .section-alt .why-cell{background:var(--cream);}
  .why-cell h4{font-family:'Lora', serif; color:var(--green-dark); font-size:1.02rem; margin:0 0 6px;}
  .why-cell p{font-size:0.88rem; margin:0; color:#514A38;}

  /* Volunteer / involve */
  .involve-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:1px;
    background:var(--line); border:1px solid var(--line); margin-top:30px;
  }
  @media (max-width:700px){ .involve-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .involve-cell{background:var(--cream-2); padding:28px;}
  .section-alt .involve-cell{background:#fff;}
  .involve-cell h4{font-family:'Lora', serif; color:var(--green-dark); font-size:1.1rem; margin:0 0 8px;}

  /* Volunteer sign-up form */
  .signup-panel{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:0.9fr 1.1fr; gap:0;
    background:var(--green-dark); border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden; margin-top:44px;
    box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(23,56,33,0.22);
  }
  @media (max-width:860px){ .signup-panel{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .signup-photo{
    background:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') center/cover no-repeat;
    min-height:280px;
  }
  .signup-form{padding:44px 40px; color:#F3EFE1;}
  .signup-form h3{color:#fff; font-size:1.4rem;}
  .signup-form p.lead{color:#CBD6C2; font-size:0.96rem;}
  .form-row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  @media (max-width:520px){ .form-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .form-field{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .form-field label{font-size:0.82rem; color:#CBD6C2;}
  .form-field input, .form-field select, .form-field textarea{
    font-family:'Inter', sans-serif;
    padding:11px 12px; border-radius:3px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color:#fff; font-size:0.95rem;
  }
  .form-field input::placeholder, .form-field textarea::placeholder{color:#9BAE92;}
  .form-field input:focus, .form-field select:focus, .form-field textarea:focus{
    outline:2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset:1px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.13);
  }
  .form-field select option{color:#111;}
  .signup-form .btn-primary{margin-top:6px; border:none; cursor:pointer; font-size:1rem;}
  .form-note{font-size:0.82rem; color:#9BAE92; margin-top:14px; margin-bottom:0;}

  /* Leadership */
  .leaders{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:40px; margin-top:36px;}
  @media (max-width:700px){ .leaders{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .leader{border-left:3px solid var(--gold); padding-left:20px;}
  .leader .role{color:var(--green-mid); font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:6px; font-weight:600;}
  .leader h4{font-family:'Lora', serif; font-size:1.2rem; color:var(--green-dark); margin:0 0 6px;}

  .partner-strip{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;
    border:1px solid var(--line); padding:22px 28px; margin-top:28px;
    background:var(--cream-2);
  }
  .section-alt .partner-strip{background:#fff;}

  /* CTA band */
  .cta-band{
    background:var(--green-darker); color:#F3EFE1; padding:56px 0;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .cta-band h2{color:#fff; font-size:1.8rem;}
  .cta-band p{color:#CBD6C2; max-width:52ch; margin:0 auto 1.6em;}
  .cta-actions{display:flex; gap:14px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap;}

  /* Contact */
  .contact-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:56px;}
  @media (max-width:760px){ .contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .contact-list{list-style:none; padding:0; margin:1.4em 0 0;}
  .contact-list li{padding:10px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:0.98rem;}
  .contact-list .label{display:block; font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--green-mid); font-weight:600; margin-bottom:2px;}

  footer{background:var(--green-dark); color:#CBD6C2; padding:36px 0; font-size:0.88rem;}
  footer .wrap{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px;}
  footer a{color:#EAD9AE; text-decoration:none;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="site">
  <nav class="nav">
    <a class="nav-brand" href="#top">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Table of Abundance logo">
      Table of Abundance
    </a>
    <ul class="nav-links">
      <li><a href="#about">Our Story</a></li>
      <li><a href="#programs">Distribution</a></li>
      <li><a href="#involve">Volunteer</a></li>
      <li><a href="#leadership">Leadership</a></li>
      <li><a href="#contact">Contact</a></li>
      <li><a class="nav-cta" href="#donate">Donate</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
</header>

<div id="top"></div>

<section class="hero">
  <img class="hero-illustration" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Volunteers smiling while packing fresh produce and pantry staples into boxes">
  <div class="hero-overlay"></div>
  <svg class="hero-rays" viewBox="0 0 400 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
    <g stroke="#EFAE33" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(0 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(20 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(40 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(60 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(80 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(100 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(120 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(140 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(160 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(180 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(200 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(220 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(240 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(260 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(280 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(300 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(320 200 200)"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="200" x2="200" y2="20" transform="rotate(340 200 200)"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="70" fill="#EFAE33"/>
  </svg>
  <svg class="hero-wheat" viewBox="0 0 200 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
    <g fill="#F6F1E4">
      <ellipse cx="60" cy="60" rx="14" ry="26" transform="rotate(-18 60 60)"/>
      <ellipse cx="80" cy="100" rx="14" ry="26" transform="rotate(-18 80 100)"/>
      <ellipse cx="100" cy="140" rx="14" ry="26" transform="rotate(-18 100 140)"/>
      <ellipse cx="120" cy="180" rx="14" ry="26" transform="rotate(-18 120 180)"/>
      <ellipse cx="40" cy="100" rx="14" ry="26" transform="rotate(18 40 100)"/>
      <ellipse cx="60" cy="140" rx="14" ry="26" transform="rotate(18 60 140)"/>
      <ellipse cx="80" cy="180" rx="14" ry="26" transform="rotate(18 80 180)"/>
      <ellipse cx="100" cy="220" rx="14" ry="26" transform="rotate(18 100 220)"/>
      <rect x="90" y="60" width="8" height="320" rx="4"/>
    </g>
  </svg>
  <div class="wrap hero-inner">
    <p class="hero-eyebrow">A food pantry serving New Orleans and the surrounding area</p>

<section id="about">
  <div class="wrap story-grid">
    <div class="story-photo">
      <img src="https://images.pexels.com/photos/735536/pexels-photo-735536.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1000" alt="Fresh garden vegetables laid out, representing the produce shared at distribution">
    </div>
    <div>
      <p class="kicker">Our story</p>
      <h2>Provision for every household we serve.</h2>
      <p class="measure">New Orleans has always fed people well, but not everyone in it gets fed well or often enough. Table of Abundance began with neighbors, congregants, and volunteers who saw the gap between the city's abundance and the households going without. The organization was incorporated in Louisiana on January 23, 2026, and later received recognition from the IRS as a 501(c)(3) public charity.</p>
      <p class="measure">Table of Abundance exists to close the gap between the food our community has and the food that reaches families who need it. Every household is welcome, regardless of circumstance. We believe meeting that need takes the whole community working together, not one organization acting alone.</p>
      <p class="measure">We're a faith-based pantry, but our table is open to everyone. Serving New Orleans and the surrounding area means showing up for the whole community. We have adopted governing bylaws and developed a launch plan for a pantry designed to serve up to 100 households per distribution, sourced through community donations and retail and grower relationships.</p>
      <div class="callout">
        <h3>Our mission</h3>
        <p>Our mission is to operate a pantry ministry that reflects God's heart of provision by creating a table where individuals and families in need are welcomed, cared for, and restored. Through the Table of Abundance Pantry, we serve with compassion and intention, offering nourishment, dignity, and encouragement in seasons of hardship. We exist to be a place of refuge and renewal, strengthening our community by caring for both body and spirit and reminding every person they are seen, valued, and not alone.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="callout" style="margin-top:20px;">
        <h3>Our vision</h3>
        <p>To create a welcoming table where individuals and families are nourished, restored, and empowered, spiritually, emotionally, and practically, so they may walk in wholeness, fulfillment, and purpose. We envision a community where no one lacks food, support, healing, or hope, and where all people have access to the tools and faith-based guidance needed to rebuild their lives and strengthen their relationship with God.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wrap">
    <ul class="fact-list">
      <li><span class="fact-label">Organization status</span><span>Incorporated January 23, 2026 · IRS-recognized 501(c)(3) public charity</span></li>
      <li><span class="fact-label">Where</span><span>Planned distribution site at Mt. Hermon Baptist Church, New Orleans</span></li>
      <li><span class="fact-label">Who we serve</span><span>Planning to serve up to 100 households per distribution across New Orleans and the surrounding area</span></li>
      <li><span class="fact-label">Food sourcing</span><span>Community donations, plus retail and grower relationships</span></li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="need" class="section-alt">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="kicker">Why this matters</p>
    <h2>Bridging the gap for New Orleans and the surrounding area</h2>
    <p class="measure">Food insecurity affects children, working families, older adults, and individuals throughout New Orleans and surrounding communities. Table of Abundance is being built to help close the gap between the food people need and the food that reaches their tables.</p>
    <div class="stat-grid">
      <div class="stat-item">
        <div class="stat-num">1 in 5</div>
        <p>New Orleanians are food insecure, including about one in three children, per New Orleans Health Department data (April 2026).</p>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-item">
        <div class="stat-num">10,600+</div>
        <p>Older adults in Orleans Parish are food insecure. The New Orleans metro area has the highest rate of senior food insecurity of any metro area in the nation, per the 2024 New Orleans Council on Aging report.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-item">
        <div class="stat-num">65%</div>
        <p>Of income-eligible Orleans Parish families are enrolled in SNAP, leaving many households with no safety net beyond community organizations.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="stat-source">Sources: New Orleans Health Department (April 2026 report); New Orleans Council on Aging (2024 report).</p>
    <p class="measure" style="margin-top:28px;">Table of Abundance exists to bridge that gap directly, and to build up the community in the process. Every distribution day is one more table set for a neighbor who needs it.</p>

    <div class="donate-panel" id="donate">
      <div>
        <h3>Why your gift matters</h3>
        <p>Table of Abundance relies on charitable contributions, grants, community partnerships, in-kind donations, and volunteer support. No fees are charged to the people we serve. Your support helps us purchase and source food, safely store supplies, support pantry operations, and distribute groceries to our neighbors.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="donate-actions">
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="mailto:abun@pantryabtble.org?subject=I%27d%20like%20to%20donate">Donate now</a>
        <p class="donate-note">Table of Abundance is an IRS-recognized 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, EIN 41-3787887. Contributions are tax-deductible to the extent permitted by law. Donors receive an acknowledgment for eligible charitable contributions. Online giving is coming soon; for now, email or call 504-396-2900.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

<section id="programs">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="kicker">What we do</p>
    <h2>Preparing for twice-monthly food distribution</h2>
    <p class="measure">Our core program will provide twice-monthly pantry distributions serving up to 100 households at a dedicated storage-and-distribution site. Volunteers and community partners will help power this work.</p>

    <img class="program-photo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Volunteers smiling while packing fresh produce and pantry staples into boxes">

    <div class="program-card">
      <div class="program-eyebrow">Program</div>
      <div>
        <h3>Twice-monthly pantry distribution</h3>
        <p>Households will receive pre-packaged boxes of fresh groceries and pantry staples at no cost, prepared and distributed by trained volunteers from our congregation and community partners.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="program-card">
      <div class="program-eyebrow">Target launch</div>
      <div>
        <h3>Full program launch, fall 2026</h3>
        <p>We're preparing to open for regular distribution by securing appropriate insurance, completing operational requirements, and building our volunteer roster.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="steps">
      <div class="step">
        <div class="step-mark">Arrive</div>
        <h4>Check in at the table</h4>
        <p>Neighbors will be greeted, checked in, and guided through a simple, respectful process that follows all applicable program requirements.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="step">
        <div class="step-mark">Fill up</div>
        <h4>Receive your box at the table</h4>
        <p>Eligible households will receive pre-packaged groceries and pantry staples, with volunteers available to help carry and load items.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="step">
        <div class="step-mark">Return</div>
        <h4>Head home, come back in two weeks</h4>
        <p>Once launched, distribution is planned twice a month to provide dependable access to food support.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="involve">

    <h2>There's a place for you at the table</h2>

        <h4>Volunteer Training · Community Engagement &amp; Fundraising · Governance</h4>
        <p>Committees that keep the organization strong, trained, funded, and well governed.</p>

    <div class="signup-panel" id="volunteer">
      <div class="signup-photo" role="img" aria-label="Volunteers smiling while packing fresh produce and pantry staples into boxes"></div>
      <form class="signup-form" id="volunteer-form" action="https://formsubmit.co/abun@pantryabtble.org" method="POST">
        <h3>Volunteer enrollment</h3>
        <p class="lead">Tell us a bit about yourself and we'll follow up with next steps. Your enrollment is sent straight to our team.</p>
        <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="New Table of Abundance volunteer enrollment">
        <input type="hidden" name="_template" value="table">
        <input type="hidden" name="_captcha" value="false">
        <input type="text" name="_honey" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
        <div class="form-row">
          <div class="form-field">
            <label for="v-name">Full name</label>
            <input id="v-name" name="Name" type="text" placeholder="Your name" required>
          </div>
          <div class="form-field">
            <label for="v-phone">Phone</label>
            <input id="v-phone" name="Phone" type="tel" placeholder="504-000-0000">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-field">
          <label for="v-email">Email</label>
          <input id="v-email" name="Email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" required>
        </div>
        <div class="form-field">
          <label for="v-interest">I'm interested in</label>
          <select id="v-interest" name="Interested in">
            <option>Distribution-day volunteering</option>
            <option>Food Sourcing &amp; Logistics committee</option>
            <option>Outreach &amp; Client Services committee</option>
            <option>Volunteer Training committee</option>
            <option>Community Engagement &amp; Fundraising committee</option>
            <option>Governance committee</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="form-field">
          <label for="v-avail">Availability</label>
          <input id="v-avail" name="Availability" type="text" placeholder="e.g. weekday mornings, every other Saturday">
        </div>
        <div class="form-field">
          <label for="v-msg">Anything else we should know?</label>
          <textarea id="v-msg" name="Message" rows="3" placeholder="Optional"></textarea>
        </div>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit" id="volunteer-submit-btn">Send my enrollment</button>
        <p class="form-note" id="volunteer-form-status">Prefer to skip the form? Email abun@pantryabtble.org or call 504-396-2900 directly.</p>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
